ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Funded"), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'FRPSA', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Working Capital Oppty' ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "NEW"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "RENEWAL") ), OR( Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Platinum WC Funding', Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Gold WC Funding', Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Diamond WC Funding', Lender_Account__r.Name = 'National Funding - Commercial WC Funding' ), OR( DATEVALUE(Fund_Date__c) > DATE(2014,02,23), TEXT(Fund_Date__c) = '' ), ISPICKVAL(Funds_Released_By__c,"") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The 'Funds Released By:' field needs to be populated prior to funding.
